payload.summary: Ranking-snapshot date gate will fail around 3 Nov 2026 if the automated snapshot-refresh PR is not merged (audit H5-1)
payload.detail: The snapshot was refreshed to 4 Oct, so the automatic checks pass today. .github/workflows/ranking-snapshot-refresh.yml runs after each weekly Eval Canary on main and opens a refresh PR once the snapshot is 14 days old, reusing the canary artifact with no provider calls. Next: watch for that PR (expected from about 18 Oct) and get it reviewed and merged before the 30-day expiry; it touches a RAG ranking fixture, so follow docs/rag-behaviour/ and the canary rules. Only if no refresh PR appears (canary failing or not running) does a new paid eval, with the owner's explicit approval, become necessary.
